title: Police Blotter: 18 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Eighteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 21, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges or federal holds — DWI, family-violence assault, drug possession, criminal trespass and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Eighteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday, November 21, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges or federal holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
